title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
- **Gram panchayat elections (SEC, Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha):** polls in **three phases – 26 Nov, 29 Nov and 2 Dec 2026**; polling **7 am–1 pm**, counting from **2 pm the same day**, and the **Upa-Sarpanch** is elected the same day; Phase II notified on **16 Nov 2026** (nominations 18–20 Nov; re-poll, if any, the next day).
- **Urban local body polls, 26 Nov 2026:** elections in **23 ULBs – 4 municipal corporations and 19 municipalities**; the Government declared a **local holiday on 26 Nov** (orders of 16 Nov 2026) and asked Collectors to get private firms to give a holiday too.
- **Incentive for unanimous panchayats (G.O. Rt. No. 1111, Nov 2026):** if the sarpanch and all ward members are elected unopposed – **₹15 lakh** (population up to 5,000), **₹25 lakh** (5,001–10,000), **₹50 lakh** (above 10,000); earlier only ₹5–20 lakh; funds only for approved village development works.
- **Ramoji Rao's birth anniversary (16 November) declared a State Function**, to be observed every year – announced by CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu** at the **Ramoji Excellence Awards, Vijayawada, 16 Nov 2026** (his **90th** birth anniversary; chief guest **Amit Shah**). Ramoji Rao (founder of **Eenadu** and **Ramoji Film City, 1996**; **Padma Vibhushan 2016**) had suggested the name **Amaravati** for the capital.
- **AP Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026–36** notified by **G.O. Ms. No. 86 (16 Nov 2026)**, IT, Electronics & Communications Dept (Secretary **Katamneni Bhaskar**), after Cabinet approval on 10 Nov: a **10-year, manufacturing-led** policy over six segments (components, robot platforms, system integration, R&D, talent, adoption) with a pathway for **hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing**.
- **Investment Protection Act:** on **14 Nov 2026** CM Naidu asked the Centre (Commerce Minister **Piyush Goyal**) to enact a **national Investors' Protection Act** so later governments cannot arbitrarily cancel approvals and incentives; AP is drafting its own law (Nara Lokesh: AP set to be the **first State** with such an Act).
- **Escrow account for industrial incentives** became operational on **12 Nov 2026** (covers MSMEs too); the CM also promised an **annual audit report on investment MoUs** and automatic cancellation of land allotments not used for the approved purpose in time – the shift from "Ease" to **"Speed of Doing Business"**.
- **TTD Special Authority (2 Nov 2026):** after the TTD Trust Board's term ended, **G.O.Ms.No.658** (Revenue–Endowments) set up a three-member Special Authority – **chairman Muddada Ravichandra (TTD Executive Officer)**, members **V. Vinay Chand** (Finance Secretary) and **K. Kanna Babu** (Endowments Secretary) – under **Section 137 of the AP Charitable and Hindu Religious Institutions and Endowments Act, 1987**, for **one year** or till a new Board is formed (previous Board: G.O.Ms.No.243, 1 Nov 2024).
- **Newborn Care Week-2026 (15–21 Nov 2026):** theme **"Newborns – Precious Wealth"**; focus on **low-birth-weight** babies; every baby discharged from an **SNCU/NICU** registered on the **Shaishav app**; home visits by ASHA/ANM/CHO on **days 1, 3 and 7** and by the Anganwadi worker on **day 28**; **SAANS** campaign against childhood pneumonia.
- **MBBS admissions 2026–27:** **Dr NTR University of Health Sciences** filled **99.88%** of seats – **7,465** seats (528 All India Quota + 6,937 State quota); women **61.34%** of State-quota admissions; **Piduguralla Government Medical College** (Palnadu) admitted its **first batch (50 seats)**. Admissions closed 16 Nov 2026.
- **Engineering fee:** interim revision of the **minimum B.Tech fee from ₹40,000 to ₹47,000**; the full fee structure for the **2026–29 block period** is to be fixed within two months *(news 17 Nov 2026)*.
- **Cyclone Akvan** (name given by **Iran**; from the Persian epic *Shahnameh*): the **third cyclone in about three weeks** after **Arnab** and **Murasu**; IMD expected it to intensify into a **very severe cyclonic storm** and cross the AP coast on **20 Nov 2026**; red alert for **seven coastal districts**; **13 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams** readied (APSDMA MD **Prakhar Jain**); CM Naidu and Dy CM Pawan Kalyan reviewed preparedness (16–17 Nov).
- **Cyclone relief:** CM Naidu met Union FM **Nirmala Sitharaman** in New Delhi on **17 Nov 2026**; preliminary losses from cyclones **Arnab and Murasu** put at **over ₹7,000 crore**; he also sought funds for the **Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub**, the **Visakhapatnam Economic Region** and **Purvodaya** funds.
- **P4 agreements at the CII Summit (13 Nov 2026):** **ITC** with the **Swarnandhra P4 Foundation** to support **25,000 families in 100 villages**; **Hero MotoCorp** – **₹32.48 crore** for **Brijmohan Munjal scholarships** to IIIT students.
- **Singapore–AP Joint Implementation Steering Committee (11 Nov 2026, CRDA office, Amaravati):** Singapore Minister **Gan Siow Huang** led the delegation; Minister **Nara Lokesh** announced that AP's **"Best Teachers"** will be trained in **Singapore** in the summer holidays, and proposed joint training of ministers and secretaries under **SAGE (Singapore–AP Governance Excellence)**.
- **Welfare hostel health survey (1–13 Nov 2026),** ordered after the two cyclones: **2,65,556 students** in **2,148** government welfare hostels examined; most common – **skin diseases (4,436)**, then **anaemia (3,218)** and dental problems (2,750).
> ⚠ Trap: panchayat polls are on **26 Nov, 29 Nov and 2 Dec**, ULB polls on **26 Nov**; the TTD Special Authority is chaired by the **EO (Ravichandra)**, not a Board chairman; Akvan's name is from **Iran**; the Robotics policy is **2026–36** (AVGC-XR is 2026–31).

The South First 2 Nov 2026 (https://thesouthfirst.com/andhrapradesh/andhra-pradesh-appoints-special-authority-to-oversee-ttd-administration/); Swarajya 18 Nov 2026 (https://swarajyamag.com/news-brief/cyclone-akvan-strengthens-to-very-severe-storm-ahead-of-friday-landfall-in-andhra-pradesh); OneIndia (https://www.oneindia.com/india/cyclone-akvan-who-named-it-what-does-the-name-mean-irans-persian-mythology-connection-explained-8260689.html); ETV Bharat 12 Nov 2026 (https://www.etvbharat.com/en/state/andhra-pradesh-to-send-best-teachers-to-singapore-for-special-training-says-nara-lokesh-enn26111202523)

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
- **NCD 4.0 survey (non-communicable diseases):** AP's fourth door-to-door screening round, launched by CM Naidu at **Visakhapatnam on 17 Sep 2025**, ended **10 Nov 2026** (14 months); **2.85 crore adults (18+)** screened for hypertension, diabetes and oral cancer and **1.46 crore women** for breast and cervical cancer; report submitted to Health Minister **Y. Satya Kumar Yadav** *(news 15 Nov 2026)*.
- **NCD 4.0 – prevalence:** **hypertension 13.93%**, **diabetes 11.45%** of adults; total **59.63 lakh** with hypertension and **48.95 lakh** with diabetes (about **34 lakh both**); **new** cases detected – **12.23 lakh hypertension, 11.58 lakh diabetes**; people over **60** account for **47.60%** of hypertension and **43.39%** of diabetes cases.
- **NCD 4.0 – districts and cancer:** highest prevalence in **East Godavari, NTR, West Godavari** (with Kakinada/Eluru for hypertension, YSR Kadapa/Eluru for diabetes); most new cases in **Visakhapatnam**; **12,768 cancers confirmed** – **breast 5,832** (largest), cervical 3,597, oral 3,339.
- **Power demand:** consumption rose **18.23%** (Apr–Nov 2026 over a year earlier), blamed on **El Niño**; peak demand projected at **14,852 MW** in the next six months (CM's Energy review, **18 Nov 2026**); since June 2024, **103 energy projects worth ₹4.20 lakh crore** approved; energy MoUs at the CII Summit **₹2.56 lakh crore**.
- **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana – AP 4th** in rooftop solar (after **Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra**): **7,39,260 households** as of **15 Nov 2026**, about **13%** of 56.97 lakh nationally (Special CS Energy **K. Vijayanand**); **Utility-Led Aggregation 68.9%** (mainly SC/ST, DISCOM installs) vs CAPEX 31.1%; **APSPDCL** leads (2,00,196). Scheme: **MNRE, Feb 2024, ₹75,021 crore**, 1 crore households, up to **300 units free** a month.
- **Liquor sales, 1–16 Nov 2026:** **beer 98.30 lakh cases** (61.20 lakh a year earlier, **+61%**); IMFL 17.95 lakh cases (14.45 lakh); combined value **₹1,421.80 crore** vs ₹1,025.74 crore (**+38.61%**); highest beer growth in **Polavaram district (160%)**, then Vizianagaram (147%).
- **Fee reimbursement (Lokesh fact sheet, 16 Nov 2026):** **₹4,962.22 crore** released since June 2024 (2024-25 ₹1,451.38 cr; 2025-26 ₹1,665.21 cr; 2026-27 ₹1,845.63 cr); **BCs** got the most (**₹2,079.01 crore**), then SCs ₹1,337.29 crore; dues inherited in June 2024: ₹3,828 crore.
- **Reservoirs and El Niño (Nellore):** **Somasila** holds only **19.70 tmc** of its **78.8 tmc** gross capacity and **Kandaleru** about **16.50 tmc**; farmers urged to grow millets, maize, pulses instead of water-intensive paddy *(news 18 Nov 2026)*.
> ⚠ Trap: NCD 4.0 prevalence – hypertension **13.93%**, diabetes **11.45%**; AP is **4th** (not 1st) in PM Surya Ghar, with **UP 1st**; beer growth topper is **Polavaram**, not Vizianagaram.
~~ Sources: Deccan Chronicle 15–18 Nov 2026 (https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/ncd-survey-detects-over-12-lakh-new-hypertension-cases-in-ap-2004672, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/cm-directs-officials-to-get-prepared-to-meet-unexpected-surge-in-electricity-demand-2005612, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/beer-consumption-soars-in-andhra-pradesh-2005273, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/lokesh-releases-fee-reimbursement-figures-counters-jagans-criticism-2005013, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/el-nino-poor-rainfall-hit-water-reserves-2005651); KPIAS APPSC CA 18 Nov 2026, from The Hindu 17 Nov 2026 (https://kpiasacademy.com/appsc-current-affairs-november-18th-2026/)

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
- **Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy 4.0 amended** (G.O.; release **18 Nov 2026**) to align with the Centre's **India Semiconductor Mission – Semicon 2.0**: AP **matches 100%** of the Centre's capital support, so a **silicon fab gets 80%** of eligible capital cost (**40% Centre + 40% State**); compound/photonics/sensor/display fabs and advanced packaging **70%**, legacy packaging **50%**; State incentives capped at **50%** of eligible fixed capital, all sources at **90%** (cf. Odisha and TN 65%, UP and MP 60%, Gujarat 56%).
- **AP Semiconductor Park, Tirupati (~5,000 acres)**, to be run by a public-private company; single window **APSGIC** (AP Semiconductor Growth and Innovation Council; Oversight Council chaired by the **CM**); **AP-SRIC** research centre to start at **IIT-Tirupati** (first focus **photonics**); **AP-STCC** training centre – subsidy **₹10,000 per trainee per month for six months**.
- **CII Partnership Summit, Day 2 (13 Nov 2026):** **12 agreements worth ₹1,41,585 crore** (10,919 jobs); largest – **AirTrunk India–JCK Infra**: data-centre campuses of **1,400 MW**, **₹1,03,018 crore** (3,120 jobs); GreenGen ₹8,000 crore; IOC ₹6,600 crore (renewables); **Jindal** ₹15,000 crore (mining, **Prakasam**).
- **Other Day-2 deals:** **Kakinada Seaports Ltd** with the **AP Maritime Board** – mechanised berth, **regasification plant** and **shipbuilding complex** at Kakinada port (**₹6,452 crore**); **APCRDA–EIH Ltd** for an **Oberoi hotel in Amaravati**; **Panchshil Realty** proposed a data centre (Anakapalli) and IT park (Visakhapatnam) worth ₹49,311 crore.
- **Saint-Gobain:** **₹1,750 crore float glass plant** at **Atchutapuram, Anakapalli district** (about 400 jobs), announced by CEO **N. Sridhar** to the CM at the summit (13 Nov 2026); it already has units at Tada and Kavali and will set up a skill centre at **Tenali**.
- **Summit totals (CM, 13 Nov 2026):** regional conferences (**194**, ₹86,522 crore) plus the summit (**109**, ₹9.02 lakh crore) = **303 agreements, ₹9.89 lakh crore, about 3.48 lakh jobs**; **11 roadshows** (5 abroad, 6 in India); proposals since June 2024 **₹32.49 lakh crore**; Amaravati to make **"Made in Amaravati" quantum computers**.
- **APCRDA–IOCL MoU** (signed at APCRDA HQ, **Rayapudi**; news 12 Nov 2026): an **Integrated Energy Master Plan** for Amaravati – city gas, PNG, CNG, **battery-swapping**, **compressed biogas** and **green hydrogen**, multi-fuel stations and utility corridors; a **Joint Working Group** to prepare DPRs; signed by APCRDA Commissioner **V. Vijay Rama Raju** and IOCL's **Piyush Mittal**.
- **Visakhapatnam Port (13 Nov 2026):** Union Ports Minister **Sarbananda Sonowal** opened a **710-m waterfront promenade (₹19 crore, 5.5 acres)** and laid stones for a **sewage-treatment upgrade (10 → 15 MLD, ₹11 crore)** and three mechanised-berth O&M contracts; the port handled a record **91.17 MMT** in 2025-26.
- **Power infrastructure (Energy review, 18 Nov 2026):** transmission network under **Green Energy Corridor-III – ₹21,838 crore**, to carry **47 GW** of renewables; **pumped-storage** proposals of **36,050 MW** at **27 sites in the Polavaram region**; rooftop solar for **2,962** welfare schools and hostels; **PM-KUSUM** – 1,162 MW at 224 locations (civil works 91%).
- **Godavari Pushkaralu 2027 (26 Jun–7 Jul 2027, main venue Rajamahendravaram):** **APPCB's ₹79-crore** project to stop sewage entering the Godavari – two STPs at **Hukumpeta (50 + 5.5 MLD)**, total capacity **85.5 MLD** with the existing 30 MLD plant, and a **17-km** pipeline from five drains; ready by **January 2027**; about **5 crore** devotees expected.
- **Palnadu water grid** (Rural Water Supply): drinking water from **Nagarjuna Sagar** to **889 villages in 33 mandals** (Palnadu, Darsi, Parchur) and 134 summer-storage tanks; allocation **2.64 tmc**; AP rejected Telangana's charge of illegal drawal of Sagar water *(18 Nov 2026)*.
- **Adani Krishnapatnam Port** inducted **288 electric vehicles** (170 e-trucks, 108 loaders, 6 excavators, 4 transfer vehicles) to replace diesel equipment – towards the Adani group's **carbon neutrality by 2040** *(18 Nov 2026)*.
> ⚠ Trap: silicon fab support is **80% = 40% Centre + 40% State** (70% for display/compound fabs); the Semiconductor Park is at **Tirupati**; **₹9.02 lakh crore** = summit alone, **₹9.89 lakh crore** = summit + regional conferences; Day-2 topper AirTrunk is a **data-centre** project, not renewables.
~~ Sources: Telangana Today/IANS 18 Nov 2026 (https://telanganatoday.com/andhra-pradesh-plans-5000-acre-semiconductor-hub-in-tirupati); Deccan Chronicle 13–18 Nov 2026 (https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/cm-holds-investor-talks-as-ap-secures-141-lakh-crore-commitments-2004252, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/saint-gobain-to-invest-rs-1750-crore-in-anakapalli-float-glass-plant-2004273, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/investment-cm-naidu-warns-of-cancellation-of-land-allotment-promises-annual-audit-of-mous-2004251, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/cm-directs-officials-to-get-prepared-to-meet-unexpected-surge-in-electricity-demand-2005612, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/ap-taking-up-79-crore-project-to-treat-sewage-ahead-of-godavari-pushkaralu-2004459, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/ap-rules-out-illegal-drawal-of-sagar-water-through-palnadu-water-grid-project-2005714, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/krishnapatnam-port-inducts-288-evs-into-operational-fleet-2005703); Maritime Gateway 12 Nov 2026 (https://www.maritimegateway.com/apcrda-and-indian-oil-join-hands-to-develop-green-energy-infrastructure-in-amaravati/); Projects Monitor 13 Nov 2026 (https://www.projectsmonitor.com/daily-wire/sarbananda-sonowal-lays-foundation-stones-for-projects-worth-rs-560-crore-at-visakhapatnam-port/)

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
- **Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026 (2nd edition):** presented at **Vijayawada on 16 Nov 2026**, the **90th birth anniversary of Ramoji Rao**; chief guest Union Home Minister **Amit Shah** (with Governor **S. Abdul Nazeer**, CM Naidu, Dy CM Pawan Kalyan); **nine** awardees (new categories **Education** and **Medicine & Health**), each **₹10 lakh**, memento and certificate; over 900 profiles considered; first edition 2025.
- **Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026 – winners (1):** **Arts & Culture – Vaikom Vijayalakshmi** (visually impaired singer; **Gayathri Veena**); **Science & Technology – Arjun Arunachalam** (**India's first home-grown MRI scanner**); **Rural Development & Agriculture – Podili Rajashekara Raju** ("**Waterman of South Zone**"); **Journalism – M. Suchitra**; **Women Achiever – V. Rukmini Rao** (co-founded **Saheli**, Delhi, 1981; Gramya Resource Centre).
- **Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026 – winners (2):** **Education – Maitreyi Jichkar** (Zero Gravity and Happy School projects); **Service to Mankind – Devendra Kumar Gupta** (**Ladli Foundation Trust**); **Youth Icon – Dr Ganesh Baraiya** (Bhavnagar, Gujarat; among the **world's shortest practising doctors**); **Medicine & Health – Dr Jemma (Aquinas) Edassery** (**Swasthya Swaraj Society**, Odisha; 96% TB cure rate). Five of the nine are women.
- **Ramoji Rao (person in news):** his birth anniversary **16 November** declared an annual **State Function** by AP (Nov 2026); founder of **Eenadu** and **Ramoji Film City (1996**, Guinness record as the world's largest film-studio complex**)**; **Padma Vibhushan 2016**; former president of the **Editors Guild of India**; suggested the name **Amaravati** for the capital.
- **Jyothi Yarraji** (Visakhapatnam; **100 m hurdles**) received her **Arjuna Award** from Union Sports Minister **Mansukh Mandaviya** in Delhi on **13 Nov 2026**, having missed the main ceremony for international meets; that day President **Droupadi Murmu** presented the National Sports Awards at **Rashtrapati Bhavan** – **no Khel Ratna** this year (first since **2014**). Governor **S. Abdul Nazeer** congratulated her.
- **AP OCTOPUS wins both NSG contests (Manesar, Haryana; 14 Nov 2026):** 1st in **Agni Pariksha-XII** (counter-terrorism, 2–14 Nov, 26 commando teams) and **Visfot Kavach-X** (counter-IED / bomb disposal, 9–14 Nov, teams of 20 States) – the **first time** AP Police won both; DGP **Harish Kumar Gupta**. OCTOPUS = **Organisation for Counter Terrorist Operations**.
- **Sri Venkateswara Museum, Tirumala** opened to the public on **16 Nov 2026** (inaugurated by CM Naidu on 16 Sep): **14 galleries on four floors**, **8,000+ artefacts**, about 1 lakh sq ft; technical support **TCS**; galleries on **Tallapaka Annamacharya**, coins, weapons, and a **Brahmandam** gallery (holograms, 360° sound); entry **₹50**.
- **Tirumala inscriptions digitised:** the **ASI** began digitising about **100 estampages** of inscriptions from the temple's prakara walls; two **16th-century Telugu** inscriptions (north wall, first prakara) record gifts of two gold cups (**374 tukaas** each) and a gold plate by **Krishnadevaraya's queens Chinnajiamma and Tirumalamma**, during the first of his **seven** recorded visits to Tirumala *(18 Nov 2026)*.
- **Kiratarjuna inscription pillar** at the **Akanna Madanna caves, Indrakeeladri (Vijayawada)** inspected on **15 Nov 2026** by Durga temple trust board chairman **Borra Radhakrishna**, who plans to highlight the ancient **Pasupata** temple there.
- **Sathya Sai Baba's 101st birth anniversary** celebrations at **Prasanthi Nilayam, Puttaparthi (Sri Sathya Sai district)**, **16–24 Nov 2026**; main day **23 Nov** at the Hill View Stadium; **10th All India Sevadal Conference** on 20–21 Nov.
- **Srinivasan (86)**, the artist who painted the **iconic image of Lord Venkateswara** (with and without ornaments) at TTD's invitation in **1970**, died *(news 14 Nov 2026)*.
> ⚠ Trap: the Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026 were the **2nd** edition (90th birth anniversary), not the first; Jyothi Yarraji got the Arjuna from **Mansukh Mandaviya**, not the President; no **Khel Ratna** in this cycle; the Tirumala gift inscriptions are in **Telugu** and of **Krishnadevaraya's** queens.
~~ Sources: ETV Bharat 16 Nov 2026 (https://www.etvbharat.com/en/bharat/ramoji-excellence-awards-2026-nine-achievers-honoured-enn26111605001); Telugu360 17 Nov 2026 (https://www.telugu360.com/ap-to-celebrate-ramoji-raos-birth-anniversary-as-state-function-12-contributions-that-shaped-his-legacy/); Telangana Today 14 Nov 2026 (https://telanganatoday.com/olympian-jyothi-yarraji-receives-prestigious-arjuna-award); The Hitavada 14 Nov 2026 (https://www.thehitavada.com/Encyc/2026/11/14/president-murmu-presents-national-sports-awards.html); Deccan Chronicle 14–18 Nov 2026 (https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/ap-octopus-wins-twin-national-championships-in-nsg-competitions-2004446, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/tirumala-sv-museum-opens-to-public-2004702, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/asi-begins-digitising-100-inscriptions-from-tirumala-temple-2005375, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/kiratarjuna-inscription-pillar-inspected-at-akanna-madanna-caves-2004703, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/all-set-for-sathya-sai-babas-101st-birthday-celebrations-in-puttaparthi-from-today-2004687, https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/andhra-pradesh/tirumala-srinivasan-painter-who-captured-lord-venkateswaras-divine-form-dies-2004297)
